tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground and the default card ground. Light is the primary theme; dark is derived (see accessibility.md).

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Quiet panels: newsletter card, media placeholders, announcement bar. Text on it: on-surface, on-surface-variant.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Chips, filled inputs, menu hover. Text on it: on-surface, on-surface-variant, accent-text.

tokens.name: surface-container-higher
tokens.usage: Pressed fills, cover tint block, track of sliders.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Disabled fills, strongest neutral field. Do not put body text below 4.5:1 on it; on-surface and on-surface-variant pass in light.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Headlines, body, labels, icons on every surface token. 18.6:1 on surface in light, 17.6:1 in dark.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Paragraph copy, nav links, meta text on surface through surface-container-higher. 9.3:1 light, 9.6:1 dark on surface.

tokens.name: outline-hairline
tokens.usage: Section dividers and card separators only. Decorative: about 1.1:1, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: SOURCE VALUE (12% ink). Edge of secondary buttons and inputs on the source site. About 1.3:1, so it fails the 3:1 non-text floor for controls. Keep for look; pair with outline-strong where the edge carries meaning.

tokens.name: outline-strong
tokens.usage: SAFE ALTERNATIVE edge for inputs, checkboxes and any control whose border is the only cue. 3.4:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, solid badges. Text on it: on-primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on primary. 18.6:1 light, 17.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill. White on it is 13.2:1 in light.

tokens.name: secondary-fill
tokens.usage: Secondary and nav button fill (translucent blue-grey). Label: on-surface.

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button hover and pressed fill. Label: on-surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: SOURCE VALUE. Focus ring on light, progress bar, large display marks, glow fields. As small text on white it is 4.0:1 and white text on it is 4.0:1, both below 4.5. Use accent-text for text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: SAFE ALTERNATIVE for links and accent text. 5.5:1 on surface in light, 8.8:1 on surface in dark. Also the fill for buttons that carry white text in light.

tokens.name: on-accent-text
tokens.usage: Label on accent-text fills (accent buttons, accent chips). 5.5:1 light, 8.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 4.0:1 on surface in light, 8.8:1 in dark; clears the 3:1 non-text floor.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Disabled button ground.

tokens.name: disabled-text
tokens.usage: Disabled label. SOURCE VALUE #6a6a71 is 4.3:1 on its light fill and 3.5:1 on dark surface; dark theme uses the safer #8b8f98 (4.9:1 on surface-container-high). Disabled text is exempt from WCAG but keep it readable.

tokens.name: announce-fill
tokens.usage: Announcement bar ground. Text: on-surface (17.6:1 light, 15.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop behind modals, with backdrop-blur-md.

tokens.name: fleck-blue
tokens.usage: Fleck and glow colour. Decorative only, never text. Approximated by eye from screenshots except blue.

tokens.name: fleck-violet
tokens.usage: Fleck and glow colour. Decorative only.

tokens.name: fleck-magenta
tokens.usage: Fleck and glow colour. Decorative only.

tokens.name: fleck-coral
tokens.usage: Fleck and glow colour. Decorative only.

tokens.name: fleck-amber
tokens.usage: Fleck and glow colour. Decorative only.

tokens.name: fleck-gold
tokens.usage: Fleck and glow colour. Decorative only.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Ground of dark media tiles (glow rings, footer band). White text on it is 21:1.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on night media tiles.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero line only, one per page. Measured 80/88 at 1440 wide. Scales with clamp(40px, 5.6vw, 107px).

styles.name: display-2xl
styles.usage: Oversized wordmark band in the footer. Fluid: clamp(38px, 10.3vw, 148px).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Poster numerals and section marks. Fluid: clamp(36px, 8.6vw, 124px).

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Large statement lines. Tight leading, keep to two lines. Fluid: clamp(34px, 6.8vw, 98px).

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section opener on wide screens. Fluid: clamp(34px, 5vw, 72px).

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Feature headline on wide screens. Fluid: clamp(34px, 3.75vw, 54px).

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Section heading (h2). Measured 42/43.68 at 1440. Fluid: clamp(28px, 2.9vw, 42px).

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: Card title, lead paragraph. 24px at every width; 20px under 767px.

styles.name: heading-5
styles.usage: Post card title, list heading. Fluid: clamp(20px, 1.5vw, 22px).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Paragraphs and large buttons. Measured at 1440; 15/22 under 767px.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Nav links, compact buttons, footer links, meta.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Button side padding (compact), card inner gap, mobile page margin.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Large button side padding, stack between title and copy.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Card padding (vertical), tile corner.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Card padding (horizontal), gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Large card padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Gap between feature rows.

tokens.name: space-5xl
tokens.usage: Section spacing, medium.

tokens.name: space-6xl
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7xl
tokens.usage: Hero and closing band breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Focus-ring corners on tiny controls, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Newsletter card on mobile, panels, mobile media tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Media tiles, feature art, newsletter card on desktop (24px under 767px).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Closing dark band corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, nav item, chip, input and badge.

tokens.name: shadow-pill
tokens.usage: Announcement bar lift. Barely visible by design.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Small raised controls and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdowns and select menus. Dark theme uses deeper black.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Dialogs and large floating panels.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Soft halo around focused inputs (add the 2px outline too).

blur.note: Backdrop blur radii measured in the source stylesheet.

tokens.name: blur-xs
tokens.usage: Chips over imagery.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and nav buttons (backdrop-filter).

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Sticky nav, announcement bar.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog scrim.

duration.note: Transition and animation durations measured on the live page.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Colour-only hover on small links.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Button fill, border and colour (ease-out). Default hover.

tokens.name: dur-menu
tokens.usage: Menu open and close (opacity, transform, visibility).

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Transform on press and arrow nudges.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Bar and pill colour, shadow and border.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Panels, tiles and slider tracks.

tokens.name: dur-cursor
tokens.usage: Blinking caret, linear, infinite.

tokens.name: dur-progress
tokens.usage: Top progress bar creeping to 70% while a page loads.

easing.note: Cubic-bezier curves declared in the source stylesheet. ease-out-quart is the one used most.

tokens.name: ease-out-quart
tokens.usage: Default for movement: menus, press, tiles (used 10 times in the source).

tokens.name: ease-out-quint
tokens.usage: Longer settles on large tiles.

tokens.name: ease-out-expo
tokens.usage: Page-level reveals.

tokens.name: ease-out-back
tokens.usage: Small springy pops (chips, toggles). Use rarely.

tokens.name: ease-in-out-quart
tokens.usage: Slider and carousel travel.

tokens.name: ease-in-out-cubic
tokens.usage: Balanced two-way moves.

tokens.name: ease-progress
tokens.usage: Top progress bar crawl (8s).

layout.note: Grid and size values measured at a 1440px viewport.

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: Side margin at 1440. Fluid: clamp(72px, 5vw, 120px) above 1440; 40px at 1024; 16px at 425.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Column gap at 1440 (12 columns). 48px under 1600 steps, 24px at 1024, 16px on mobile.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Sticky nav height.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Large button: 10px 24px padding, 17.5px label.

tokens.name: button-height-compact
tokens.usage: Compact button: 6px 16px padding, 14.5px label.

tokens.name: bp-xxs
tokens.usage: Smallest phone.

tokens.name: bp-xs
tokens.usage: Phone.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Tablet portrait, 4-column grid below.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet landscape, 8-column grid below.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Measurement width; full 12-column grid.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Content stops growing; margins grow instead.
